name: Friendship
description: Friendship word search puzzles gather calm adult social English for adults and seniors — bond, companion, letter, circle, cheer, trust and shared-time words — without dating-app brands or licensed characters. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays soft and grown-up: chat, care, ally, comfort and visit vocabulary many lifelong friends already use. This hub pairs well with Kindness and Gratitude when you want a longer gentle social session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as steady as a weekly call.
